routes.name: Kennedy School, NE Portland -> Esther Short Park, Vancouver WA
routes.note: The cross-river trip, run northbound on the Oregon pack because that is the pack a Portland rider has. Two bike crossings exist -- the Interstate Bridge sidewalk and the I-205 Glenn Jackson path 11 km east -- so the question is which one the router picks and what it charges.

routes.name: Drake Park, Bend -> Phil's Trailhead, Bend
routes.note: The ride every Bend rider makes: downtown out to the west-side trailhead. Tests the approach to an MTB network from a town centre, with allowMtbTrails at its default.

routes.name: University of Oregon, Eugene -> Spencer Butte trailhead
routes.note: Willamette Street is the direct line and is a fast arterial; the south-hills residential grid is the alternative. A short urban-to-trailhead trip with a real corridor choice.

routes.name: Southern Oregon University, Ashland -> Britt Gardens, Jacksonville
routes.note: Rogue Valley rural, off the Bear Creek Greenway that round 2 found clean. OR 99 and Old Stage Road are the two candidate corridors.

routes.name: Cannon Beach -> Manzanita
routes.note: US 101 over Neahkahnie Mountain: no parallel road, a sustained climb, and a stretch with very little shoulder. The coast findings so far are all south of Tillamook.

routes.name: Troutdale -> Multnomah Falls Lodge
routes.note: The Historic Columbia River Highway, the piece of the Gorge that is intact and rideable. B3's freeway fix was measured on the severed piece further east; this checks the healthy half.

routes.name: 5th Street Public Market, Eugene -> OSU Memorial Union, Corvallis
routes.note: Long inter-city: OR 99W, the Peoria Road river route, and the Coburg/Harrisburg east-bank route are three genuinely different answers, so the portfolio has something to be right or wrong about.
